title: WaveVerif: Acoustic Side-Channel based Verification of Robotic Workflows
abstract: arXiv:2510.25960v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: In this paper, we present a framework that uses acoustic side-channel analysis (ASCA) to monitor and verify whether a robot correctly executes its intended commands. We develop and evaluate a machine-learning-based workflow verification system that uses acoustic emissions generated by robotic movements. The system can determine whether real-time behavior is consistent with expected commands. The evaluation takes into account movement speed, direction, and microphone distance. translated_title: WaveVerif：基于声学侧信道的工作流验证方法
translated_abstract: 本文提出了一种利用声学侧信道分析（ASCA）来监测和验证机器人是否正确执行预期指令的框架。我们开发并评估了一种基于机器学习的工作流验证系统，该系统利用机器人运动产生的声学发射信号。系统能够判断实时行为是否与预期命令一致。评估考虑了运动速度、方向和麦克风距离等因素。结果表明，在基线条件下，使用四种不同的分类器（支持向量机、深度神经网络、循环神经网络和卷积神经网络），单个机器人运动可以以超过80%的准确率进行验证。此外，诸如拾取-放置和打包等工作流也能以类似的置信度进行验证。我们的发现表明，声学信号能够支持实时、低成本的机器人工作流监控。
tldr: 本文提出WaveVerif，通过分析机器人运动产生的声学信号，利用机器学习分类器实现高准确率的实时工作流验证，无需额外硬件。
en_tdlr: This paper presents WaveVerif, a framework that verifies robotic workflows in real-time by analyzing acoustic emissions from robot movements, achieving over 80% accuracy with machine learning classifiers.
